name: waff

attributes.attribute: gains a few more years of life

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Waff is a British folkloric figure. The name was used in Yorkshire for a Co-Walker. A Co-Walker is a spirit double that appears near a person's death. A person could speak sharply to the waff to drive it off. The frightened spirit then departed. The speaker won extra years of life in return.

okr.objective: Waff names a spirit double of Yorkshire.
